title: Think Like a Scientist: Analysis, Synthesis and Discussion
objective: Students combine information from more than one source and write cautious academic conclusions.
context: Report A: A team saw more frogs at a shaded pond than at an open pond on one morning. Report B: Another team saw similar numbers at two ponds on one evening.

items.prompt: State the main finding of each report.
items.answer: A: more frogs at the shaded pond. B: similar counts.
items.hint: Write one short line per report.

items.prompt: Compare the reports in one sentence. Use “while” or “however”.
items.answer: Accept an accurate contrast between the difference in A and similar counts in B.
items.hint: Start with: Report A found ___, while Report B found ___.

items.prompt: Suggest one reason the findings may differ and one way to check it.
items.answer: Example: The time of day may matter. Count at each site in the morning and evening on several days.
items.hint: Use may for a possible explanation.
